academic.passage: The theory of relativity, proposed by Albert Einstein, has fundamentally changed our understanding of fundamental physics. It includes two main concepts: special relativity and general relativity. Special relativity deals with the physics of objects moving at constant speeds, while general relativity introduces the impact of gravity on space-time. These theories reveal that time and space are not absolute but can vary based on relative motion and gravitational forces, leading to practical applications in modern technology, particularly in navigation systems like GPS.
